data.name: Lunge (Mythic)
data.description: Your reaching strikes aid your defenses against those you hit. Whenever you use Lunge and hit a creature with the melee attack, you no longer take a -2 penalty to AC against that creature. You can expend one use of mythic power when you use Lunge to negate the -2 penalty to AC whether you hit or miss, and gain a +2 bonus on attacks of opportunity you make while Lunge is in effect.
